items.verbatim: IMPROVING OTITIS MEDIA WITH EFFUSION DIAGNOSIS IN THE PRIMARY CARE SETTING WITH THE LASER OTOSCOPE - ABSTRACT MSTATT (ALSO KNOWN AS LIGHTHANDED) IS DEVELOPING A SAFE, LOW-POWER DIGITAL LASER OTOSCOPE FOR THE IMPROVED IDENTIFICATION AND DIAGNOSIS OF OTITIS MEDIA WITH EFFUSION (OME) IN YOUNG CHILDREN.
